domains.frontend-ui: Writing web UI code: pages, React/Next components, CSS/Tailwind, shadcn/Cult/Material 3 libraries, htmx, accessibility. NOT aesthetic direction, restyling or design critique (design-visual) and NOT backend/APIs (backend-infra-deploy).
domains.design-visual: Visual design direction and review: aesthetic style systems, design-token extraction, redesigns, UI/design critique, mockup variants, brand kits, logos, posters. NOT writing production UI code (frontend-ui) and NOT AI image prompting (image-gen).
domains.image-gen: AI still-image generation: image prompts, GPT-Image prompt libraries, image-direction references for web/mobile screens. NOT video prompts or rendering (video-audio) and NOT HTML/CSS graphics (design-visual).
domains.backend-infra-deploy: Server-side and ops: APIs, databases/SQL schemas, auth, webhooks, MCP servers, n8n, cloud cost, observability, deploys to Vercel/Railway/Supabase/GitHub, ship/merge/release flow. NOT testing, debugging or code review (code-quality-testing).
domains.code-quality-testing: Verifying and fixing code: QA/testing, debugging and root cause, code review (requesting/receiving), security audits, performance and health checks, benchmarks. NOT building features (frontend-ui, backend-infra-deploy), reviewing plans (planning-strategy-review) or explaining how code works (research).
domains.browser-web-data: Driving a browser and pulling data from the web: headless or real-browser automation, scraping, crawling, screenshots, cookies, browser skills. NOT open-ended topic research (research) and NOT QA fix/health verdicts (code-quality-testing).
domains.writing-en: English prose craft: de-AI humanizing, proofreading, plain-English and developer docs/READMEs, copy critique, one-pass polish. NOT persuasive marketing copy (marketing-growth-seo) and NOT Vietnamese text (writing-vi).
domains.writing-vi: Vietnamese-language text work: humanizing, grammar checking, translationese cleanup, VN style guide, VN factual reference. NOT English writing (writing-en).
domains.marketing-growth-seo: Marketing and growth: persuasive copy, ads, social posts, content strategy/calendars, blog and SEO/GEO/AEO, marketing assessments, lead funnels, feedback routing. NOT neutral docs (writing-en) and NOT video/image production.
domains.video-audio: Video and audio production: HyperFrames compositions and animation adapters (GSAP, Lottie, Three, anime.js, CSS, WAAPI), Remotion, ffmpeg, subtitles, music, narration scripts, video prompts. NOT still-image generation (image-gen).
domains.decks-docs-reports-charts: Presentation and document artifacts: slide decks, HTML plans/reports, PDFs, charts, diagrams, spreadsheets, file-to-markdown conversion. NOT writing prose content (writing-en) and NOT Google Docs/Sheets/Slides API operations (google-workspace).
domains.planning-strategy-review: Thinking, planning and reviewing around building: idea refinement, brainstorming, plans, decision stress-testing, migration/deprecation planning, CEO/eng/design/devex plan reviews, strategy, product/ops/workflow critique, contract review, quality loops, OpenSpec, end-to-end feature pipelines. NOT writing the code itself.
domains.google-workspace: Anything done through the gws CLI on Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Chat, Meet, Tasks, Keep, Contacts, Classroom and Apps Script. NOT local .xlsx/.pptx files (decks-docs-reports-charts).
domains.claude-system-ops: Operating the Claude Code agency itself: spawning/handoff, context and session save, project status briefings and PD swarm checks (recall, swarm), lessons and memory upkeep, skill creation/import/quality and rewriting skill front-matter descriptions, task DB, safety guardrails, prompt engineering, Claude Code harness config (settings.json hooks, permissions, keybindings) and Claude Code mods (panes, bands, status lines). NOT product work for a client project.
domains.research: Gathering and synthesizing information: web and social research, briefings, in-depth research pipelines, codebase knowledge graphs, NotebookLM notebooks. NOT driving a browser or scraping (browser-web-data) and NOT project status briefings (claude-system-ops).
domains.career-personal: Job search and personal career work: scoring job offers, ATS CVs, cover letters, interview prep, application tracking. NOT general writing (writing-en).

agent-browser.hint: Use for headless automation and QA with health scores; not for the user's real Chrome (browser-harness) or light data fetch (lightpanda).

agent-dispatch.why: Main-session/PD routing procedure (act directly vs delegate, spawn choice); loaded via the CLAUDE.md on-demand table, no Exec task loads it

auto-researcher.hint: Use for quick proactive WEB research with sourced evidence; not for project status (recall); for multi-stage in-depth research use pipeline-research.

browse.hint: Use for headless QA/dogfooding of LIVE sites with screenshots; not report-only QA gates (qa-only), local-app capture (webapp-testing), scraping or the user's real Chrome.

browser-harness.hint: Use when automation needs the user's real Chrome with sessions/cookies; not for isolated headless runs (agent-browser, browse).

cc-loop.hint: Use to iterate a deliverable to a quality bar with parallel critics; for one polish pass use content-polish.

connect-chrome.why: Alias of open-gstack-browser (frontmatter name = open-gstack-browser); route to the real dir

content-creator.hint: Use to draft conversion-focused ads, social posts, hooks and scripts; not for long-form strategy (content-strategy) or SEO audits.

content-critique.hint: Use to review/audit existing copy with a severity report (never rewrites); to fix prose use humanizer, stop-slop or content-polish.

content-polish.hint: Use for a one-pass publish-ready polish of EN or VI drafts (humanize + proofread); not for a single narrow edit (use humanizer or proofreader alone).

context-pressure.why: Agent context-% lifecycle procedure (save-state/respawn at 75/80%); triggered by CONTEXT_PCT_ALERT, no Exec task loads it

coord-respawn-self.why: Coord self-respawn at context 80% mid-L3; invoked by the Coord itself, never an Exec skill

copywriting.hint: Use to write/improve persuasive marketing copy (landing pages, ads, emails); not for neutral docs (tech-writer) or social post drafting (content-creator).

cso.hint: Use for infra-first security audits (secrets, supply chain, CI/CD, STRIDE); not for a code-level OWASP pass (security, security-critique).

deck-narrative.hint: Use to review/fix a deck's argument and action titles; not to build or style a deck (co-load a deck skill).

delegate.hint: Use to hand a task to a subagent with full context snapshot; not to spawn another PD (pd-spawn) or hand off between agents (task-handoff).

dept-resume.why: Department session-start lifecycle command; no Exec task loads it

dept-save-state.why: Renamed to dept-wrap (skills/INDEX.md: "RENAMED -> use dept-wrap"); dept-wrap SKILL.md says renamed from it

dept-wrap.why: Department session-end lifecycle command; no Exec task loads it

design-critique.hint: Use to critique a UI/design from screenshots or Figma; not for live-site visual QA (design-review) or reviewing a plan (plan-design-review).

design-review.hint: Use for live-site visual QA (spacing, hierarchy, AI-slop); not for screenshot/Figma critique (design-critique) or plan review (plan-design-review).

design-taste-frontend.hint: Use for anti-slop landing pages/portfolios with strong visual direction; not for plain component building (frontend) or UI audits (impeccable).

excalidraw-diagram.hint: Use for Excalidraw JSON diagrams that make a visual argument; not for data charts or formal diagrams.

extract-design.hint: Use to pull design tokens/colors/fonts from a URL; not for component/motion/structure analysis.

ffmpeg.hint: Use as FFmpeg/FFprobe command reference for media ops; not for conversational editing (video-use).

firecrawl-agent.hint: Use for autonomous structured web extraction; not for known single URLs (firecrawl-scrape) or link crawls (firecrawl-crawl).

firecrawl-crawl.hint: Use to bulk-extract a site by following links; not for single-URL scrapes (firecrawl-scrape).

firecrawl-scrape.hint: Use to scrape specific URLs to markdown via Firecrawl; not for whole-site crawls (firecrawl-crawl) or autonomous extraction (firecrawl-agent).

frontend.hint: Use to BUILD a frontend UI/component from scratch; not for restyling/critique passes (impeccable) or bold visual direction (design-taste-frontend).

github-deploy.hint: Use to scaffold GitHub Actions deploy workflows and secrets; not for Vercel/Railway CLI deploys.

grammar-checker-vi.hint: Use to proofread Vietnamese spelling/punctuation/grammar; not to restyle (humanizer-vi) or fix translationese (translationese-cleaner-vi).

gws.hint: Use to pick the right Google Workspace service skill or run multi-service gws work; for one service operation use that gws-* skill directly.

html-plan-style.hint: Use for ANY HTML page made for human review: plans, reports, ADRs, digests, sampler or comparison pages; not for slide decks (marp, strategic-deck).

humanizer.hint: Use to rewrite EN AI-sounding prose, tuned to doc type (CV/blog/email); not Vietnamese (humanizer-vi) or rubric scoring (stop-slop).

humanizer-vi.hint: Use to edit mechanical/monotone Vietnamese; not for grammar-only fixes (grammar-checker-vi) or English-calqued text (translationese-cleaner-vi).

humanizer-writing.hint: Use when drafting/editing EN prose to avoid AI tells (alias /hw); not Vietnamese (humanizer-vi) or full proofreading (proofreader).

hw.why: Pure /hw shortcut that invokes humanizer-writing; route to humanizer-writing instead

hyperframes.hint: Mandatory entry point for any HyperFrames video; then load the specific hyperframes-* or adapter skill.

hyperframes-media.hint: TTS narration (Kokoro), transcription (Whisper) and background removal for HyperFrames assets; does not clone voices or dub video.

image-prompt-engineer.hint: Use to write/debug still-image generation prompts; not for video prompts or for driving an image tool.

image-to-code.hint: Use to generate a design image first and then build the site from it; not for plain frontend builds without an image step (frontend).

impeccable.hint: Use to redesign, critique, polish or harden an existing frontend UI; not to build from scratch (frontend) or for backend-only work.

inbox-tasks.why: Main-session rule for where an ownerless task's tracking file lives; filing plumbing, no Exec task loads it

investigate.hint: Use to debug with root-cause phases (gstack); same discipline as superpowers-systematic-debugging; not for runtime-failure triage (self-healing).

land-and-deploy.hint: Use to merge the PR, wait for CI/deploy and verify prod; for first-time config use setup-deploy, for the full flow use pipeline-deploy.

lessons-sync.hint: Use to copy new root lessons into projects at session boundaries; not to curate or dedup them.

lightpanda.hint: Use for fast, light browsing/data retrieval without rendering; not for screenshots or visual checks (browse, agent-browser).

make-pdf.hint: Use to turn a markdown file into a finished PDF; not for building slides (marp) or HTML decks.

marp.hint: Use for Markdown-to-slides via Marp (PDF/PPTX/HTML); not for HTML plans (html-plan-style) or the 25-30 slide strategic deck (strategic-deck).

memory-crosslink.why: Memory-file linking convention (See also: [[stem]] wikilinks) loaded via the CLAUDE.md on-demand table when editing memories; not a task skill

nexus-gatekeeper.hint: Use only to enforce a task-store gate that blocks a task until PASS is recorded; not for a one-off independent QA check (qa-only).

open-gstack-browser.hint: Use to launch the visible GStack Chromium with sidebar; not for headless automation (browse, agent-browser).

pd-resume.why: Session-start lifecycle command run by parent/PD boot; no Exec task loads it

pd-routing.why: Main-session procedure for forwarding project work to a running PD or spawning one; no Exec task loads it

pd-showcase.why: Toggle for live-demo mode of pd-spawn/pd-resume; session switch, never an Exec task

pd-spawn.hint: Use for a PD to hand work to another Project Director; to hand a task to a subagent with context use delegate.

pipeline-audit.hint: Use for a full multi-critique audit of a whole system (pre-launch); not for a focused security audit (security, cso).

pipeline-deploy.hint: Use for a verified deploy only (pre-checks, canary); not when the task also covers planning/building the feature (pipeline-feature).

pipeline-feature.hint: Use for the full plan->critique->QA->ship->deploy flow of ONE feature end to end; not for deploy-only (pipeline-deploy) or a single stage.

pipeline-research.hint: Use for in-depth multi-stage research (competitors, context); not for a quick lookup (auto-researcher).

pipeline-seo-geo-aeo.hint: Use for a standalone 7-stage SEO/GEO/AEO audit; not for on-page reference rules (seo-aeo-best-practices).

plan-design-review.hint: Use to rate a design PLAN on 0-10 dimensions before building; not to critique built UI (design-critique, design-review).

proofreader.hint: Use to proofread typos/grammar/flow in EN, VI or mixed text; not to restyle or de-AI prose (humanizer, stop-slop).

qa.hint: Use to test a web app AND fix the bugs found; not for report-only health scores (qa-only).

qa-only.hint: Use for report-only QA with a 0-100 health score, never fixes; not when fixes are wanted (qa).

quality-loop-router.hint: Use as the final step of a creative pipeline to choose Mode A loop or Mode B approval; not for the loop itself (cc-loop).

railway-deploy.hint: Use to deploy to Railway (link, env vars, logs, domain); not for Vercel, Supabase or GitHub Actions deploys.

recall.hint: Use to brief on ONE project's current state and next steps from its memory files; not for web research (auto-researcher) or all projects at once (swarm).

receiving-code-review.hint: Use when acting on review feedback (verify, then implement item by item); not for performing or requesting a review (review, requesting-code-review).

requesting-code-review.hint: Use to dispatch a structured two-pass review before merge; not to review a diff directly (review, code-review) or act on feedback (receiving-code-review).

respawn-self.why: PD self-respawn at context >=80%; invoked by the PD itself, never chosen for an Exec task

resume-bod.why: Board/council session-restore command run by parent session; no Exec task loads it

review.hint: Use for gstack pre-landing review of the branch diff; not to dispatch a structured review (requesting-code-review) or act on feedback (receiving-code-review).

room-manager.why: Background 10-min chat-room polling loop; infrastructure plumbing, not an Exec task skill

room-manager-digest.why: 12h cron dept-room digest; infrastructure plumbing, not an Exec task skill

save-state.why: Session-end lifecycle command; no Exec task loads it

scrape.hint: Use to pull data from one page via the gstack browser; not for mutating flows (clicks/forms) or bulk crawls (firecrawl-crawl).

security.hint: Use when code touches auth, secrets, input or payments (OWASP checks with fixes); not for infra-wide audits (cso) or report-only reviews (security-critique).

security-critique.hint: Use for a report-only AppSec review with file:line citations (never rewrites); for fixes use security, for infra audit use cso.

self-healing.hint: Use when a script/build/command fails (two attempts, then escalate); for deep root-cause use superpowers-systematic-debugging.

seo-aeo-best-practices.hint: Use as an SEO/GEO/AEO knowledge base while writing/fixing pages; for a full 7-stage audit use pipeline-seo-geo-aeo.

setup-deploy.hint: Use to configure deploy settings before /land-and-deploy; not to run the deploy itself.

ship.hint: Use to run the ship workflow (merge base, tests, review, version bump, PR); not to merge/deploy (land-and-deploy).

simple-english.hint: Use for plain/STE-style English docs for non-expert readers; not for general AI-tell cleanup (humanizer) or developer docs (tech-writer).

stop-slop.hint: Use to strip filler and AI tells with a 50-point rubric; not for full proofreading (proofreader) or Vietnamese (humanizer-vi).

strategic-deck.hint: Use for a 25-30 slide strategic pitch/audit deck (pptxgenjs); not for HTML plans or reports (html-plan-style), Marp slides (marp) or reviewing a deck's argument (deck-narrative).

style-guide-vi.hint: Use to enforce a consistent Vietnamese style guide (address terms, terminology, numbers/dates); not for grammar (grammar-checker-vi).

subtitle-burner.hint: Use to burn karaoke-style captions into short vertical video; not for general video editing (video-use).

supabase-deploy.hint: Use to link Supabase, push migrations and deploy edge functions; not for app hosting (vercel-deploy, railway-deploy).

superpowers-receiving-code-review.hint: Superpowers 6-step variant for acting on review feedback; not for performing a review (review, code-review) or requesting one.

superpowers-requesting-code-review.hint: Same description as requesting-code-review; prefer requesting-code-review unless in the superpowers flow; not for acting on feedback.

superpowers-systematic-debugging.hint: Use for five-phase root-cause debugging of bugs/test failures; not for quick failed-command triage (self-healing).

superpowers-writing-plans.hint: Use to turn an approved spec/epic into a file-level task plan with dependencies (sprint planning); not for diagrams (excalidraw-diagram).

swarm.hint: Use to get a one-line status and blockers from EVERY project director at once; not for a single project (recall).

task-handoff.hint: Use when an agent finishes work that unblocks another agent; not to delegate a task with a context briefing (delegate).

tech-writer.hint: Use for developer docs, READMEs, API refs, changelogs, runbooks; not for plain-English rewrites (simple-english) or marketing copy (copywriting).

translationese-cleaner-vi.hint: Use for Vietnamese that reads like literal English translation; not for plain grammar (grammar-checker-vi) or legal/standard-term changes.

ui-ux-pro-max.hint: Broad UI/UX knowledge for pages, dashboards and design systems; for pure building prefer frontend, for critique impeccable.

unwrap.why: Inbox task pickup lifecycle command run by parent session; no Exec task loads it

vercel-deploy.hint: Use to deploy to Vercel (link, env vars, preview/prod, logs); not for Railway, Supabase or GitHub Actions deploys.

video-use.hint: Use to edit video by conversation (transcribe, cut, grade, overlays); not for HyperFrames HTML compositions (hyperframes).

webapp-testing.hint: Use to test or capture a LOCAL web app with Playwright scripts (boot it, screenshots at viewports); not for QA health scores (qa-only) or live-site dogfooding (browse).

wrap.why: Session-end inbox-task wrap command; lifecycle plumbing, no Exec task loads it

xlsx-toolkit.hint: Use for local .xlsx/.csv work (formulas, pivots, merge); for Google Sheets API operations use the gws skills.

code-review.description: Review the current diff/PR for correctness bugs at an effort level; built-in command
code-review.hint: Use for a quick built-in correctness review of a diff/PR; not the gstack checklist (review), dispatching one (requesting-code-review) or acting on feedback.

simplify.description: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes; quality only, not bug hunting; built-in command
simplify.hint: Use to clean up changed code (reuse, simplification, efficiency) and apply fixes; not to hunt bugs (code-review).

security-review.description: Security review of the pending changes on the current branch; built-in command
security-review.hint: Use for a built-in security review of pending branch changes; for infra audits use cso, for report-only AppSec critique use security-critique.

plugin-authoring.description: Make a Claude Code mod: a live pane, band, status line, toast or hook inside Claude Code (terminal or desktop), written as a plugin of function hooks that hot-reloads; load before writing or debugging a hooks module; built-in
plugin-authoring.hint: Use to build or debug a Claude Code mod (pane, band, status line, toast, hooks module); not settings.json hooks/permissions (update-config) or new skills (skill-creator).

claude-api.description: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK: model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, prompt caching, token counting, model migration; built-in
claude-api.hint: Use when code calls the Claude/Anthropic API or SDK, or for Claude model, pricing, limits or caching facts; not for prompt wording alone (promt-engineering) or building an MCP server (mcp-builder).

update-config.description: Configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json: hooks for automated behaviors (whenever/before/after X), permissions and allowlists, env vars, hook troubleshooting; built-in
update-config.hint: Use to edit settings.json hooks, permissions or env vars; not to build a mod/pane (plugin-authoring), keyboard shortcuts (keybindings-help) or derive an allowlist from transcripts (fewer-permission-prompts).

keybindings-help.description: Customize Claude Code keyboard shortcuts: rebind keys, add chord bindings, edit ~/.claude/keybindings.json; built-in
keybindings-help.hint: Use only for Claude Code keyboard shortcuts and keybindings.json.

fewer-permission-prompts.description: Scan past transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts; built-in
fewer-permission-prompts.hint: Use to cut permission prompts by deriving an allowlist from transcripts; for one specific permission or hook edit use update-config.

dataviz.description: Library-agnostic chart design method for any chart, plot, dashboard, stat tile or sparkline (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, SVG, PNG): chart form heuristic, accessible categorical/sequential palettes, mark specs, interaction rules; built-in
dataviz.hint: Use for chart design quality (form, color, accessibility) in plotting code, app UIs or reports.

notes: Skill-router menu overlay. It assigns every shipped skill (keyed by directory name) a routing domain or an exclude reason; the menu builder fails loudly if a skill has no entry. Add entries with scripts/skill-route-overlay-add.py (default entry is excluded as 'internal'; pass --domain and --hint to make a skill routable).
